defs.def: to make sth full of sth; to become full of sth （使）充满，装满，注满，填满

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: Four years later, those beautiful 10 acres of fields had turned into 20 acres filled with over 400,000 sunflowers.
ex.t: 四年后，那片美丽的10英亩田地变成了20英亩，种满了超过40万株向日葵。

ex.s: Such thoughts filled her mind.
ex.t: 这样的想法充满了她的脑海。

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
ex.t: 微塑料已成为全球普遍的污染源——它们沉积在深海和喜马拉雅山上，卡在火山岩中，填满海鸟的胃，甚至落在南极的新鲜积雪里。

ex.s: My husband and I had just sold our house and we were busy ___41___ the beloved home our family had spent 23 years filling up.
ex.t: 我和丈夫刚卖掉房子，正忙着___41___我们家花了23年填满的这个心爱之家。

ex.s: “Age is just another bot- her attempting to convince you of the impossible in the world, but actually the world is filled with possibilities,” she once said.
ex.t: “年龄不过是另一个试图让你相信世界上不可能的事的bot-her，但实际上世界充满可能，”她曾说。

ex.s: Often, they’ll end up filling the area with small stones and using chemicals to control weeds.
ex.t: 通常，他们最终会用小石子填满该区域，并用化学药剂控制杂草。

ex.s: Now, every year when my husband pulls our camper out of the garage, we are filled with a sense of _____54_____, wondering what camping fun and _____55_____ we will experience next.
ex.t: 现在，每年当我丈夫把露营车从车库开出来时，我们心中充满了_____54_____，想知道下次我们会经历什么样的露营乐趣和_____55_____。

ex.s: Helen was walking down the street late ____11____ the evening, her arms filled with grocery bags.
ex.t: Helen深夜____11____走在街上，怀里抱着杂货袋。

ex.s: The twins were filled with excitement as they thought of the surprise they were planning for Mother's Day.
ex.t: 当他们把早餐端到母亲床上时，母亲会有多么高兴和自豪啊。

ex.s: The twins were filled with excitement as they thought of the surprise they were planning for Mother’s Day.
ex.t: 双胞胎想到他们正在为母亲节准备的惊喜时心中充满了兴奋。

ex.s: Filled with   64   (curious), the artist packed his bags and left.
ex.t: 充满   64  （好奇心），这位艺术家收拾行李离开了。

ex.s: My drawer quickly filled.
ex.t: 我的抽屉很快就装满了。

ex.s: 37      If the air you’re breathing is clean-which it would be if you’re away from the smog of cities-then the air is filled with life-giving，energizing oxygen.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 37      如果你呼吸的空气是干净的——当你远离城市的烟雾时确实如此——那么空气中充满了赋予生命、充满活力的氧气。

ex.s: A child's day is filled with fascination， newness and wonder.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是停止在事情发生之前预测我们将要看到和感觉到的东西。

ex.s: Though the movie is 30 years old, most of the 250 seats were filled with teary-eyed audience wanting to say good-bye to the old building.
ex.t: 尽管这部电影已有30年历史，但250个座位几乎坐满了眼含泪水的观众，他们想向这座老建筑告别。

ex.s: It was filled with surprises and amusements, all because of my mother---loving, sweet, yet absent-minded and forgetful.
ex.t: 生活中充满了惊喜和趣事，这一切都因为我的母亲——充满爱心、温柔甜蜜，却又心不在焉、健忘。

ex.s: Filled with anger, you tend to say whatever comes to your mind.
ex.t: 充满愤怒，你倾向于说出你脑海中浮现的任何事情。

ex.s: At first Ryan was nervous, but soon a great warmth filled him.
ex.t: 起初瑞安很紧张，但很快一股巨大的温暖充满了他的全身。

ex.s: There is comedy in the texts of Ancient Greece, and medieval writings are filled with jokes.
ex.t: 古希腊的文本中充满了喜剧，中世纪的著作充满了笑话。

ex.s: By mindfully seeking out opportunities ____17____ (stimulate) this feeling, you could fill your life with greater meaning.
ex.t: 通过有意识地寻找机会____17____（激发）这种感觉，你可以让生活充满更大的意义。

ex.s: Museums, once quiet places filled with history, are now full of digital excitement.
ex.t: 博物馆曾经是充满历史气息的安静场所，如今却处处洋溢着数字化的活力。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: I always read ,using different voices ,as though I were acting out the stories with my voice and they loved it !It was a special time to bond with my children and it filled them with the wonderment of books .
ex.t: 我总是用不同的声音朗读，仿佛用声音把故事演出来，他们很喜欢！那是一段与孩子建立亲密关系的特别时光，也让他们充满对书籍的惊奇。

ex.s: Before _____64_____ (head) home, they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, at prices significantly _____65_____ (cheap) than those found in supermarkets.
ex.t: 在_____ 64 _____ （头部）回家之前，他们在购物袋中装满来自当地农民的新鲜水果和蔬菜，价格比超市中的价格便宜_____ 65 _____ （便宜）。

ex.s: Directions: After reading the passages below, fill in the blanks to make the passages coherent and grammatically correct.
ex.t: 说明：阅读下面短文后，填空使短文连贯。

ex.s: It fills more slowly, but all the same, it fills.
ex.t: 它注满得更慢，但同样，它会注满。

ex.s: For the blanks with a given word, fill in each blank with the proper form of the given word; for the other blanks, use one word that best fits each blank.
ex.t: 对于带有给定单词的空白,在每一个空白中填写给定单词的正确形式;对于其他空白,使用一个最适合每个空白的单词.

ex.s: And because these spaces are filled with solid ice, liquid water cannot readily get inside, but it can when the permafrost melts, allowing more water to get through.
ex.t: 由于这些空间充满了坚实的冰，液态水不容易进入其中，但当永久冻土融化时就可以，从而让更多的水渗透过去。

ex.s: The second drawer began to fill and as it did I wondered whether there were bigger discoveries out there, not just species, but life that depends on things thought to be useless, life even without DNA.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉开始装满，就在它装满时我想知道外面是否还有更大的发现，不只是物种，还有依赖被认为无用的东西生存的生命，甚至没有DNA的生命。

defs.def: to block a hole with a substance 堵塞，填补（洞、孔）
to make sb have a strong feeling 使充满（感情）
if a smell, sound or light fills a place, it is very strong, loud or bright and easy to notice 使遍及；弥漫；布满；照满
full of the thing mentioned 构成形容词
to stop people from continuing to want or need sth 满足

ex.s: The human body is 60% water and we need to drink lots of water to be healthy When we are thirsty we just go to the kitchen and fill a glass with clean water.
ex.t: 人体60%是水，我们需要喝大量水来保持健康。口渴时，我们只需去厨房倒一杯干净的水。

ex.s: Fill in each blank with the word or phrase that best fits the context .
ex.t: 当17岁的夸特罗·穆瑟和朋友聚会时，他们不喝啤酒也不和约会对象开车兜风。相反，他们坚持参加攀岩或谈论书籍等适合所有年龄的活动。

defs.def: to do a job, have a role or position, etc. 担任；充任
to appoint sb to a job 派人担任
to use up a particular period of time doing sth 耗去；打发；消磨
to make sb/yourself feel unable to eat any more （使）吃饱

ex.s: A． fill our senses to feel the wonders of the world
ex.t: A．充分运用我们的感官去感受世界的奇迹

defs.def: if sb fills an order or a prescription, they give the customer what they have asked for （按订单）供应；交付（订货）；（按药方）配药

ex.s: Last week our teacher asked us to fill in a questionnaire.
ex.t: 上周老师让我们填一份问卷。

defs.def: to complete a form, etc. by writing information on it 填写（表格等）

ex.s: *Fill out desired information:location, job type, etc
ex.t: *填写期望的信息：地点、工作类型等

ex.s: Motivation letter：You should have your motivation letter ready before filling out the application form．
ex.t: 动机信：你应该在填写申请表之前准备好动机信．

ex.s: What should applicants do before filling out the application form？
ex.t: 申请人在填写申请表之前应该做什么？

ex.s: Please review the List of Available Projects and fill out the Group Project Request Form.
ex.t: 请查阅“可参与项目列表”并填写团体项目申请表。

ex.s: Make sure you fill in the attendance sheet at each session to record your attendance.
ex.t: 确保每次课程都填写考勤表以记录出勤情况。

ex.s: Fill in the attendance sheet.
ex.t: 填写出勤表。

ex.s: You also have to wonder at the unique madness of a language in which a house can burn up as it burns down, in which you fill in a form by filling it out, and in which an alarm is only heard once it goes off!
ex.t: 您还必须惊讶于一种独特的疯狂语言，在这种语言中，房子可以在燃烧时燃烧，您可以通过填写表格来填写表格，并且只有在警报响起时才会听到警报！

defs.def: to fill sth completely 填满；塞满

ex.s: His grandmother filled his backpack with candy to make him a little less____30____ .
ex.t: 他奶奶在他的背包里塞满了糖果，让他不那么____30____。

ex.s: "To fill in a form" means the same as "to fill out a form".
ex.t: "fill in a form"和"fill out a form"意思相同。

ex.s: 36   And it is good time to fill the new space with love and hopefully presents.
ex.t: 36  这正是用爱和 hopefully 礼物来填满新空间的好时机。

ex.s: Directions: Fill in each blank with a proper word chosen from the box.
ex.t: 说明：从方框中选出合适的词填入每个空白处。

defs.def: to spend time doing sth while waiting for sth more important 消磨，打发（时间）

ex.s: Register online or fill out a Group Play Registration Form with multiple date and start time options.
ex.t: 在线注册，或填写团体活动注册表，提供多个日期和开始时间选项。

ex.s: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties and just to fill the time.
ex.t: 我们在婚礼、生日、办公室聚会上跳舞，有时只是为了打发时间。

defs.def: to complete a drawing, etc. by covering the space inside the outline with colour 给（图画等）最后着色

ex.s: Fill in each blank with a proper sentence given in the box.
ex.t: 用方框中给出的适当句子填入每个空格。

defs.def: as much of sth/sb as you are willing to accept 填满 … 的量；足够 … 的量
as much as you can eat/drink 吃饱的量；喝足的量
